title: SkillLoadResult
description: Output contract for the skill_load MetaprojectOperation. Draft — see docs/requirements/keryx-skills-runtime-tools/specification.md section 3.2.

name.description: The requested skill name or path, echoed back.

path.description: Resolved project-relative path to the SKILL.md that was read. Empty string when found is false.

content.description: The SKILL.md body verbatim, including frontmatter. Never formatted, summarized, or truncated (specification.md section 3.2). Empty string when found is false.

found.description: False when name/path does not resolve to a known skill; content and path are empty rather than the call erroring (specification.md acceptance criterion AC3).
